newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa sees 96 profit near last year's - report.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa sees 96 profit near last year's - report.

text.p: German airline Lufthansa AG expects to earn about as much in 1996 as it did in 1995, Chairman Juergen Weber said in a newspaper interview.

According to a report in the daily Frankfurter Rundschau, Weber said that assuming that things go as planned in the next few weeks, the company's profit would "at least not be far from the 1995 result."
But he added that there was no reason to celebrate. Return on sales would "not be satisfactory."
In 1995, the airline reported a group profit from ordinary activities of 756.3 million marks and return on sales was 3.8 percent.
